dataset_name: NASA LSDA Reaction Self-Test & Astronaut Sleep Actigraphy Archive
original_source: NASA Life Sciences Data Archive (LSDA) / Human Research Program (HRP)
organism_or_population: Human (24 Long-Duration Active Astronaut Crew Members)
mission_or_experiment: ISS Expeditions 19-33 Behavioral Health & Performance Experiment
known_limitations: Controlled Human Research Data: Individual crew level time-series requires formal NLSP data request approval.
Sleep actigraphy can overestimate sleep during motionless resting wakefulness.
Data partitioning must be strictly grouped by astronaut subject ID to prevent data leakage.
usage_and_access_restrictions: Controlled Access: Requires NASA Life Sciences Portal (NLSP) HRP Data Request approval.
